text: Text stories are the only live path (no LLM, illustration behind CloudIllustrationAccess), so a silent picture-only companion has no carrier in the text engine today. Engine-side the only hook would be an illustration-requirement field on the page plan (companion emotion = page emotion), which is cheap but belongs to illustration-system. Question to book-research: did the mirroring companion also have a text role elsewhere in those books, or was it silent throughout?
